name: Velkaantuneet
overview: Riku fights to keep his home as the threat of foreclosure looms. Mira has fallen into debt by ordering food on installment plans when the outside world feels too overwhelming. The series follows four people struggling with uncertainty and constant financial hardship. When there’s no money to pay the bills, they’re torn up and thrown straight into the trash. In the midst of a cycle of debt, is it still possible to find a path back to ordinary life and a new beginning? A documentary series produced by Sami Kieksi.
